device_entry.name: 中央控制器（CC）
device_entry.description: 这是一种用于量子比特实验的可编程序列与时序控制设备，用于汇编并运行控制序列、分发数字触发与同步信号、协调CCIO接口模块，并支持DIO校准、状态监测以及时序延迟调节。它常用于超导量子计算实验中的脉冲序列执行、系统同步和联调。
device_entry.description_en: This is a programmable sequence and timing control instrument for qubit experiments. It is used to assemble and run control sequences, distribute digital trigger and synchronization signals, coordinate CCIO interface modules, and support DIO calibration, status monitoring, and timing delay adjustment. It is commonly used in superconducting quantum computing experiments for pulse sequence execution, system synchronization, and bring-up.
